profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHint: You sign in with this address: a one-time code comes to it.
profile.displayNameHint: Used when Leo greets you and in answers.
profile.workRoleHint: Leo uses it to pitch examples and terms to your field.
profile.timeZoneHint: Meeting times and dates show in this zone, and Leo counts deadlines by it. Automatic follows this browser.
profile.timeZoneMore: Find other zones by name or city

avatar.hint: Any image works. It’s cropped square and resized for you.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Delete your account and everything in it. You have 7 days to change your mind.
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Your account is deleted in 7 days: chats, notes, files, prompts, memory and settings, and any subscription is cancelled. Sign in before then to cancel.
deleteAccount.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}. Sign in before then to keep it.
deleteAccount.reauthenticate: To confirm it’s you, enter the code we sent to {email}.

devices.signOutFailed: Couldn’t sign out of that device

messengers.title: Messengers
messengers.description: Link your messenger to ask Leo from a team chat. Leo acts there with your rights.

telegram.refused: This Telegram account is linked to another Shosai account. Unlink it there first.

slack.proposed: Is this you? <account></account> has your email.
